en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a town square bordered by classic European-style buildings. The central building in the image is likely the town hall, with a prominent clock tower at the top. Other buildings have storefronts with German signage, and several people are walking or standing in the open square, which is paved with cobblestones. At the top, the text 'Bischofswerda Markt' is printed in red.
